title: Separate annual-report performance measure

source.publisher: Office of the Auditor General, Halifax Regional Municipality
source.title: 2025-26 Annual Report and 2026-27 Audit Priorities

parent.relationship: Separate historical measure from the same publisher; not a shared recommendation cohort.

explanation: The annual report pairs its 70% result with an 80% target for implementation after 18 months. It describes improvement from the previous year’s 43%, while noting five years below target. This is a separate historical performance measure, not a result for the three audits in the October 2026 follow-up above.
limits: The annual-report page does not give the underlying recommendation count or an exact status observation date. Neither is inferred.
Do not combine the 70% annual-report measure with the 44% follow-up summary, subtract them to claim a trend, or apply this target to a different cohort.
No result against the 2026-2030 action plan is established here. No current completion, financial loss, legal breach or personal wrongdoing is inferred.
